scenes.name: title
scenes.narration: Vigil. A post-quantum rollup on QoreChain, with a watchtower that never sleeps.

scenes.name: home
scenes.caption: Vigil: a rollup that checks itself
scenes.narration: Vigil is a post-quantum rollup on QoreChain with its own watchtower. Every batch is re-executed the moment it lands, and a wrong one is challenged before it can settle. On the right, the watchtower's live view of the latest batches.

scenes.name: why
scenes.caption: Without a watcher, a forged batch becomes final
scenes.narration: QoreChain accepts every batch at once and gives the world an hour to prove it wrong. Without a watcher, a forged batch becomes final and its fake balances are withdrawn. With Vigil, it is caught in seconds.

scenes.name: diagram
scenes.caption: Sign, batch, check, settle, record
scenes.narration: Users sign with M L D S A. A bonded batcher submits each batch with a post-quantum anchor. The watchtower re-executes it, and final batches are recorded on chain by a contract that checks the signature itself.

scenes.name: catch
scenes.caption: A forged batch, stopped in 5 seconds
scenes.narration: This really happened on the testnet. An attacker bonded a thousand Q O R and posted a forged batch. Two seconds later the watchtower found the wrong state root. Three seconds after that, its fraud proof was confirmed. The chain threw the batch out, and the attacker's bond was slashed.

scenes.name: live
scenes.caption: Live on the QoreChain testnet
scenes.narration: Everything is live: every batch, its verdict, its challenge window, and every service's heartbeat.

scenes.name: end
scenes.narration: Vigil. Open source, and running now.
